deckSpread.name: Fortunes of Ravenloft
entries: Madam Eva's reading determines the location of three treasures, the identity of an ally, and the location of Strahd himself.

positions.name: The Tome of Strahd
entries: This card tells of history. Knowledge of the ancient will help you better understand your enemy.

positions.name: The Holy Symbol of Ravenkind
entries: This card tells of a powerful force for good and protection, a holy symbol of great hope.

positions.name: The Sunsword
entries: This is a card of power and strength. It tells of a weapon of vengeance: a sword of sunlight.

positions.name: Strahd's Enemy
entries: This card sheds light on one who will help you greatly in the battle against darkness.

positions.name: Strahd
entries: Your enemy is a creature of darkness, whose powers are beyond mortality. This card will lead you to him!

deckSpread.name: One-Card Spread
entries: For the simplest reading, draw a single card from the deck. The card presents a message about the day to come, or provides quick guidance concerning an immediate problem.

positions.name: The Card
entries: A message about the day to come, or guidance on an immediate problem.

deckSpread.name: Three-Card Spread
entries: A three-card spread allows the cards to tell a story, as the cards interact with each other and their meanings resonate and connect.

The most common form interprets the cards as past, present, and future. Alternatively they might represent a problem, an obstacle, and the solution; or the questioner, another individual, and the relationship between the two.

positions.name: Past
entries: Forces in the past that are relevant to the question; alternatively the problem, or the questioner.

positions.name: Present
entries: The present situation; alternatively the obstacle, or another individual.

positions.name: Future
entries: A hint at the future; alternatively the solution, or the relationship between the two.

deckSpread.name: Five-Card Spread
entries: A five-card spread allows a question to be answered with great complexity and nuance, as the cards show multiple perspectives and weave an interconnected story.

positions.name: The Quest
entries: This represents the adventure itself or the current situation.

positions.name: That Which Is Hidden
entries: Things in the questioner's past, elements of the subconscious, hidden enemies, or things forgotten or neglected. These forces weigh down the questioner and impede completion of the quest.

positions.name: That Which Is Needed
entries: The tools necessary for success on the quest—the help of an ally, a useful item, or knowledge the questioner must acquire.

positions.name: The Challenge
entries: The chief obstacle to success: the thing most likely to prevent the questioner from achieving the quest.

positions.name: The Outcome
entries: The culmination of the adventure, or the ramifications and consequences that follow the quest's success or failure.

deckSpread.name: Tarokka Reading
entries: A fortune teller reveals the significance of each card's position and what the card represents, interpreting the cards through the lens of the focus.

positions.name: Position 1
entries: The focus of the reading and the lens through which the other cards are interpreted

positions.name: Position 2
entries: The past, something that might or might not be apparent to those other than the focus

positions.name: Position 3
entries: What opposes the focus, whether literal opponents or obstructing fortunes

positions.name: Position 4
entries: The future, an omen of what's to come and a fate that might still be changed

positions.name: Position 5
entries: What aids the focus, whether literal allies or advantageous events

deckSpread.name: One-Card Spread
entries: A one-card reading is good for a quick check-in. It can be used to obtain clarity on a choice that you need to make or to keep a message in the forefront of your mind for the day.

positions.name: The Card
entries: Clarity on a choice to be made, or a message to keep in the forefront of your mind.

deckSpread.name: Three-Card Spread
entries: Three-card readings are most usually used to explain the past, present, and future, but they can also mean "Problem, Obstacle, Solution" or "Thoughts, Feelings, Action."

positions.name: Past
entries: The past; alternatively the problem, or thoughts.

positions.name: Present
entries: The present; alternatively the obstacle, or feelings.

positions.name: Future
entries: The future; alternatively the solution, or action.

deckSpread.name: Five-Card Spread
entries: A five-card spread allows the reading to unfold fully and gives a deeper message with more complexity and nuance.

positions.name: Situation
entries: This card represents the current situation, problem, and/or objective.

positions.name: Behind the Scenes
entries: This card shows what is working behind the scenes in the psyche. Rooted in the past, this influence must be brought to light to be utilized or released.

positions.name: Focus
entries: This card represents things that you need to focus on as you resolve your quest.

positions.name: Develop or Release
entries: This card denotes something to develop or let go of so you can advance your quest.

positions.name: Resolution
entries: This card is the resolution of the answer or shows what is needed to resolve the problem fully.
